## Launch Your BNPL Solution
#### Kick Off Your Project with Confidence
Assemble your team and meet our onboarding experts. Together, we’ll set a clear, efficient timeline to launch your BNPL project seamlessly.
#### Seamlessly Integrate Roonyx with Your Banking Core
Follow our intuitive integration guides to connect Roonyx with your banking systems. Our integration team will work hand-in-hand with your IT department for flawless setup.
#### Embed BNPL into Your Digital Ecosystem Smoothly
Strategically position BNPL within your online banking platform. Roonyx will create a seamless, branded user experience that aligns with your institution’s identity.
#### Tailor Your Underwriting Parameters Precisely
Define your BNPL loan parameters, fee structures, and more to align with your institution’s specific goals and preferences for optimal performance.
#### Leverage a Comprehensive Marketing and Communication Kit
Utilize our turnkey marketing kit, customized and branded for you, covering everything from pre-launch announcements to post-launch campaigns for maximum impact.
#### Execute a Flawless Test and Launch
Conduct real-time testing of your BNPL workflow to ensure everything is functioning perfectly. Once validated, confidently launch your BNPL solution to the market.
